# Native entity interaction wire reference

`entity-interact-777.json` was generated by the adjacent original Java probe using
the official verified Minecraft26.3 ServerboundInteractPacket.STREAM_CODEC. It
contains payload bytes, not packet IDs, game assets or implementation code.
Server provenance/hash is pinned in data/target.json. Cases include both hands,
secondary action, signed relative points, zero and extended LP-vector scales.
The Rust regression compares exact independent bytes, without invoking its own
encoder to generate expectations. Protocol777 uses one Interact packet with an
LP Vec3 location; the legacy interact/interact-at action enum is inappropriate.

Generate with JDK25 and the already verified extracted vanilla server classpath:
`javac -cp "$VANILLA_SERVER_CLASSPATH" -d "$ACCEPTANCE_DIR" ProbeEntityInteract.java`
then `java -cp "$ACCEPTANCE_DIR:$VANILLA_SERVER_CLASSPATH" ProbeEntityInteract entity-interact-777.json`.
